description.p: Adept UI is an AI filmmaking and production studio from ANOINT Inc. It brings characters, storyboards, images, video, voice, and the timeline together so a creator can direct a film in one application.
Create characters, build storyboards, generate images and videos, direct scenes, and finish a film in one application. Local models and hosted API services stay separate choices.
ComfyUI is a manual prerequisite for local generation. Commercial API models do not require it.
The Universal Launcher installs a newer signed release with the platform installer and keeps personal projects.
The first launch records the installed version, so Adept UI checks the signed release catalog before opening.
The Windows installer starts Adept UI through the Universal Launcher, which now sits beside the application instead of inside its resources folder.
Full API Installation no longer stops on FFmpeg. Adept UI checks the signed release catalog before the application opens.
Shared Setup Wizard with inline API provider keys for Windows, Ubuntu, Fedora, and Apple Silicon. Full API Installation does not require ComfyUI or local generation models.

Beta 1.1.1 for Fedora x86_64. The Runtime Supervisor identifies its own control plane, Creator Engine is not required to open the application, and ComfyUI stays a manual prerequisite for local generation.
